title: Spent $1000 in Fable credits to make this, did I get scammed?
author: Caninetechnology
selftext: Could’ve made it with Kimi for much cheaper, but it wasn’t out when I developed this. Would mean the world for anyone to try this out, even just to make fun of it 😂

comments.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
comments.body:
No reason for this to cost 1000$  
At this budget u could have gotten Claude max x20  
And then you get essentially near infinite Claude 5 Opus Ultracode...

replies.author: Caninetechnology
replies.body: With the new Kimi i probably couldve made this in 200$, in a few months theyll probably be a model that will do this in a 20$ subscription

replies.author: Caninetechnology
replies.body: Sunk cost, I kept thinking if I add one more feature the game will be perfect and then continued that loop for a few days. It was almost similar to chasing gambling losses lol. Obviously with the new cheaper/better models I look dumb af for spending this much on fable

comments.author: Epyx911
comments.body: Look it's not worth $1000 but its fun to play...id pay $1.99 to 3.99 to have this on Steam.

replies.author: Caninetechnology
replies.body: This is amazing someone took their time to play Ares Outpost, thank you for the honest feedback! 🙏

replies.author: Epyx911
replies.body: Honestly it was fun. I really enjoyed playing it. I think you could have pulled this off in Opus 4.8. Music and sound effects have a real 80s arcade vibe and the play is paced nice.

replies.author: Caninetechnology
replies.body: This is what i was afraid of… I guess its ice cube sandwiches for this month 🤦‍♂️

replies.author: -svde-
replies.body:
godspeed. i am curious, and no hate/not making fun of you but genuinely curious, how the hell did you spend that much on a single game? i see the assets and all the components you listed on the itch page but still… idk how you could possibly splash that much usage across a single build like this. was it just the sheer amount of assets + way too many iterations? did you leave it unattended and let it run auto edits? how granular did you get with instructions and guidelines? 

from what i can see you at the very least got a cohesive look and feel out of it, which is more than a lot of vibers can claim. 

hell, i’ll give it a go in a little bit. let you know what i think. it reminds me off the jump of a lot of the old school rts pc games i used to play as a kid.

replies.author: One-Hearing2926
replies.body: Did you try these new models? I was working on a simple game, spent 2 weeks worth of gpt 5.6 tokens in 2 days, then I ran out really wanted to finish a feature, bought 20$ credits, and spent them in 2 hours... And I wasn't even using the highest thinking one!!!

replies.author: -svde-
replies.body: tbh idk what constitutes a “simple game” to you but if your usage is being drained like that it sounds like there might be something wrong with your setup

replies.author: Will_X_Intent
replies.body: I am literally eating ramen to save money to afford shit like this.  Can't wait for smarter models to get cheaper.

comments.author: VanillaMammoth1937
comments.body: Guys chill out there's no way he spent $1000 on this, this is just a marketing tactic. Like "Wow, he spent $1000 of Fable credits, this game must be interesting, let me check out what Fable is able to do with that much token spend"

replies.author: RiffRuffer
replies.body: The "I quit my job, need to feed my dog, and divorced my wife" of ai game dev

replies.author: Caninetechnology
replies.body:
In all seriousness I spent 800-900, I got taxed from Fable each prompt cost like 50-100$. It generated every single art asset, sound, animated enemies/turrets, dialogue characters, literally everything. 

But like another comment said at best this is like a 3.99 game on the steam store which im ok with. I will probably just tinker with this game as a hobby project

replies.author: Jealous-Mode3792
replies.body: Why ? Why though? Claude max x20 and have it fan out tiered agents ? You could have built this for $200 month subscription in under a week

replies.author: VanillaMammoth1937
replies.body:
? Claude doesn't even have image-generation capabilities so I know you're lying. 

And even if it was true, you would be insanely stupid to spend money generating images and sound with Fable when you could get it for free or for much cheaper from Gemini or GPT.

replies.author: -svde-
replies.body:
op doesn’t need anyone to stand up for him and i hate most of what vibe coding has done to the world of development and programming but just fyi you absolutely get image generation via claude in a  variety of ways 

\- the general ai/app can create svgs and other programatic visuals 100% in-house   
\- code can use skills that intake from mcp/api/third party connections   
\- code and cowork can both straight up actively drive any app or website if you give them enough parameters (or use mcps as above) so they can use most visual design tools 

and a few other similar types of setups. while anthropic doesn’t have actual image diffusion models in any of their shit, you can definitely get the apps and modes to create images. that said most generated assets look like absolute shit anyway and it totally removes any sense of artistic direction or expression or heart imho but nothing new there

replies.author: -svde-
replies.body:
you say that as if he would benefit in any way from anthropic getting more money lol. there’s no affiliate and i assure you the company doesn’t need to  
market like this. 

also it’d be a *terrible* ad for fable or anthropic in general considering you could do this in quite a few passes with opus and sonnet at $20/mo most likely

replies.author: VanillaMammoth1937
replies.body: I'm saying that he's marketing his own game. Maybe marketing isn't the right word as I don't think he's making money, but he's using this story to get people to play his game. It's not a bad strategy as I'm sure several people have tried it out because the post header caught their eye.

comments.author: papapumpnz
comments.body: I think the question is, would i pay $10 for this in a game store? Hmmm, maybe $5. But its fun for a 5min break.

comments.author: loontoon
comments.body:
Not the type of game I would normally play, but I gave it good playtest.

Frankly too much going on for me to understand what was happening. 

I thought it looked good and could definitely see some people paying for this.

comments.author: theflossboss1
comments.body: If this was a free game on kongregate I might play it… not a chance in hell I would spend money on it though lol

comments.author: nayheyxus
comments.body:
I mean, if its what you wanted to make, I wouldn't consider it a scam. Imagine 10 years ago what it would of costed to hire people to make it.

I built an app when ai coding became legit, it cost me around 300, but I sank all of my free time into it, even learning to code a bit.(since I stupidly built in on base44 and exported it out). I would of gladly paid 1000 to get back some of the year I squander.

comments.author: Dull_Mention_7456
comments.body: I can see lots of passion in it but you need to improve the description. I don't see anything described as fun there. What's the game about? City builder? Survival builder? Strategy?

comments.author: luka_makes_games
comments.body: A bit dumb yeah, but I 100% recognize the sunken cost feeling. You know you are ignoring glaring unaddressed issues but keep adding features hoping that the problem will disappear
